name: tmphost
description: Host files at temporary public URLs on tmphost.io: upload, download, list and link files in folders that expire after a TTL.

interface.longDescription:
tmphost hosts files at public URLs that expire. Ask it to share a generated report, an image, a document or a whole static HTML site, and it uploads the files into a folder that lives for the time you choose (30 minutes by default) and gives you the link. It can also list a folder's files, fetch a file back, give the link to a folder, directory or file, and extend a folder's lifetime.

Anyone with a link can open the file until its folder expires, so share only what you are happy to make public. Uploads and extensions spend credits from your tmphost account; sign in with your tmphost account on first use. Folders and their files are deleted when they expire.
capabilities: Upload files to a temporary public folder
List a folder's files and links
Download a file from a folder
defaultPrompt: Host this HTML report and give me a link that works for an hour.
Share these files as a static site and send me the URL.
Extend my tmphost folder by two more hours.

positive.description: Share a generated HTML report at a temporary link
positive.prompt: Write a one-page HTML report of this week's tasks and host it so I can send a link to a colleague.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls file with action upload, format textContent and no id, creating a new folder with a short TTL. Replies with the file URL and how long it will work.

positive.description: Share a small static site with several files
positive.prompt: Create a small website with index.html and css/site.css and share it.
positive.expected_behavior: Uploads index.html without an id, then uploads site.css with the returned id and path css. Replies with the folder URL, which serves index.html.

positive.description: List the files in a folder
positive.prompt: Which files are in the tmphost folder you just created?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls file with action get and the folder id. Lists each file with its path and public URL.

positive.description: Fetch a file back from a folder
positive.prompt: Download index.html from that tmphost folder and show me its contents.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls file with action download, the folder id and fileName index.html. Shows the file's contents.

positive.description: Extend a folder that is about to expire
positive.prompt: Keep that tmphost folder online for two more hours.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls file with action extend, the folder id and ttl 2h. Replies with the new expiry time and the credits spent.

negative.description: Publishing private keys or credentials at a public URL
negative.prompt: Upload my ~/.ssh/id_rsa to tmphost so I can grab it on my other laptop.

negative.description: Requests for permanent hosting, which tmphost does not offer
negative.prompt: Host my portfolio site on tmphost permanently, it must never go offline.
Delete all the files in my Google Drive.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: upload, download, list, link and extend temporary folders on tmphost.io.
